text:
zara: deploybot blocked the cut: artifact signature verification failed on the backend image. holding promotion.

deploy-bot: [automatic] release/2026.05.02 job image:verify failed (signature mismatch)  logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/1759101112

devin: paste the tiny snip please, which step?
zara: image-sign step on build-runner-21. snip: 
```
VERIFY: backend-image:sha256:77a3...
expected signing key id: key-prod-03
actual signature key id: key-rotated-07
STATUS: SIGNATURE_MISMATCH
```

pat: oof, looks like a sig rotation on the signing service. Could be the key rotated mid-build or the signer returned a different key due to propagation lag.
andre: option A: rerun -> likely pick up the new key and pass but costs ~15-20m. option B: pin to last-known-good signed image for the change window.
ops-oncall: change window closes in ~30m. rerun might still fit but marginal (build + post-verify ~18m). If we rerun and it passes we keep fresh signature; if rerun fails, we delay. Pinning unblocks now but we must document and ensure rollback plan.
devin: what's last-known-good?
zara: last-good signed image: backend:sha256:ab9f... signed with key-prod-03 at 1759060000. I can pin and run a small canary.
pat: rollout suggestion: pin to ab9f..., start 2% canary for 10m, promote if metrics stable. create follow-up ENG-4767 to investigate signing-service rotation and ensure atomic key publishing. fallback: immediate rollback to previous tag if error-rate >0.4% or 5xx spike.
andre: agree. We should also message infra that key rotation happened outside expected window. tagging infra-team in ENG-4767.
ops-oncall: monitoring thresholds set. Will escalate if anomalies in the canary window.
devin: add release note line: \"Pinned backend image due to CI signature mismatch; full rerun and signer audit scheduled post-release (ENG-4767).\"
zara: running pin + canary now:
```
# pin signed image
deploybot pin --release release/2026.05.02 --component backend --image backend:sha256:ab9f...
deploybot promote --release release/2026.05.02 --mode canary --percent 2 --duration 10m
```

deploy-bot: [automatic] pinned backend image to sha256:ab9f...; canary started 2% at 1759101220.

ops-oncall: watching dashboards; first 5m looks normal. no latency or error spikes.
pat: ENG-4767 created and assigned to infra/signer. includes build-runner-21 logs and signer trace IDs.
devin: updating release notes and pinging #customer-facing with the blurb.
zara: canary completed healthy at 10m; promoting to 100% now. promote command executed at 1759101398.
deploy-bot: [automatic] promote completed to 100% at 1759101405. release cut unblocked.
ops-oncall: follow-up tasks: 1) rerun full build+verify outside change window and attach logs to ENG-4767; 2) infra to audit key rotation process and add a signer propagation check in CI; 3) consider temporarily pausing automatic key rotations during change windows.
pat: noted. closing thread.
